title: A Word at the Well

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: A figure goes up the clay road in a locked box; a word comes up from the well and stops on the stone lip. Neither carries a name under it, and the yard keeps both.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the Clay Yard, told on the twelfth morning of Ilmen

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of four hundred and five to four hundred and seven days, six months and two hundred and twenty-five to two hundred and twenty-seven days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody; count 405 exact at the opening on answer 384, closing at 407 exact on answer 390. The old life rides the surgeon's register alone: no present-tense break is spent in this chapter and no \memory{} tag is used, the white room, the page over the speakers and the hands that stayed in the field going on gathering interest from Chapter 113. No departure from the boy's eyes: the Debt Loft is a sound from above and behind, the back room a shape and a dust, the Drawing a room seen and not entered, and the well a stone lip and a bucket-round from the basket's low angle. Corin opens on the hand laid flat on the fold on answer 384 in the small hours, and the year's first arithmetic has gone up the clay road in Berr Clay's locked box with the key gone up in a coat pocket that never comes back down and no key in his hand; it is one reading and not an account, not a signature, not a payer and not a thirteenth, the figure read still not the figure paid, and nothing from Ilmen 10 crosses back under the roof as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. Each morning the register takes the body in its old order — one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool; the empty place beside it holding the fold of wool Sella put there on the fifteenth, found where put and still a finding, not a placing; the thread of drool stiff in the dry kiln heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread; cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, as at the end of a line written out for it; the Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — while the infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle quarrels without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning. Hessa Rale is not on stage: only a word comes up once from the yard well that the woman who carries the slate once carried a figure that named a person she knew, a fifth shaping of the well-saying on its own tray with a finger between it and her eighth hand and the road saying, with no owner standing, no name spoken, no reader made and no sixth shaping made due; Ilva stays at the well with her notched strip unread and is expressly not the speaker of any voice. The soft-cuffed clerk stays a reported shape set below the north bridge for a measure nobody called, the man from Slate Row a face on its own tray and never a tenth hand, a sale or a witness, and Berr gone up the road believing well of himself and not brought back. Three ordinary tending days, each opened by its own dated \daymark and lived in two full scenes; Ilmen 20 (Day 414), the month's second Account-day, stands seven mornings beyond the close and is not brought into a day that has not earned it.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Eleventh Morning
scenes.synopsis: First entry, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{405}{Ilmen 11, Y.H. 814, Firstday}: the small hours opening on the hand laid flat against the fold on answer 384 and the count exact at 404, then first light and the morning under the Vail kiln-house roof. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn at the kindling, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge; Garl Vail in objects only (salt-stiff coat with its left-shoulder crease on the peg, hollow wheel-seat, clean dark line at the Vail corner with its finer grey called the thaw thickened in the dry cold with the faint sour tang of Ash, twice-mended pot's hairline between old-brass staple and tighter wire, unforged collector sentence at the kindling, uncalled tile debt). Walk-ons only: neighbours going about an ordinary Firstday in the Clay Yard. No Berr, Hessa, Ilva, collector, officer, reading, market, Cross or bell; no ownerless voice over the boards — the Ash 5 joining and the Ash 17, Ash 23 and Stone 23 directions stand where put, do not repeat and buy no lesson (T035/T031/T065/T095 held). New day, new date, no recap: the hand on the fold is the present moment, not a retelling, and nothing from the first Account-day crosses forward as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. Dramatic purpose: the surgeon takes the body in its old order and knows a face composed by cold is not composure, that a cold patient cannot clot and must be rewarmed slowly from the outside, never hurried, never rubbed, and that pink returning is the surface still lying over a cold core, while the infant's three wants quarrel without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086). He keeps four hundred and five exact against a house that keeps its days in loaves, glances and an unnamed space at the row's end and does not stand the number up as a threshold or a figure (T071/T072). Sella comes to the hearth before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, gives intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, keeps her finger above the unread charcoal, moves her lips on a two-gapped row, glances once at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first where the wire crosses the crack with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, turns the dressed grain under wool with no figure or handful and sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed; she carries him down and up the nineteen steps at the half-pace from every open slate, goes wide around the seven walked-around places once and not twice, widest around the returning-line place, sets him under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, adds no second fold, and leaves the widow's mark untouched (T058/T079/T100, T077, T009/T013/T092, T098 carried). At the kindling Tarn keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged sentence, passes his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, and does not turn his head toward the landing; the ear-sentence stops at the calling word as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, the Seed 16 breath stays unspent, the loan uncalled and the fear of vagrancy his without a figure (T036/T076/T006). At the wheel-shed Jorra parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, knows a pot's full note three turns ahead and withholds it, and puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence without the extra holding of Ash 26; *he's not Vail* stays sealed and the promise under the shed neither given nor withdrawn (T062/T035/T031). Answer 385 filed: exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer; six honest answers stand on the sixth place, 380 through 385, not one a doctrine. The carried fire gives four low pulls with the fifth unsupplied, its payer unnamed four hundred and five days; Garl's name unspoken the same number, the two counts standing side by side without becoming one (T088). Textures: elm-bark smoke, tallow, grey dust ground small as meal past a bent finger, the leathery crust hardened further in the dry heat, cold stopping at wrist, the river's note low under its winter skin through the finger's-width door. Foreshadowing planted, not paid: the first arithmetic gone up the road gathers toward the district's far-off accounting and is not laid across the twelve old findings to make a row come out even (T015/T041/T047 held); Ilmen 20 stands seven mornings beyond the close and is not named as a threshold. Emotional turn: the adult's exact inventory of a body at rest held against the infant's loud hunger, neither winning, the surgeon finding a small clean satisfaction in a field taken as found and left as found and knowing it costs nothing. Last image: the hand outside the wool comes up an inch toward the river's note under its winter skin (the inch is not a reach), takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing, lets it go as the note ended — neither early nor stayed — and comes straight down and lays itself flat against the fold on answer 385, the crust's corner standing a hair off the wool and the thread frozen and unwiped.

scenes.title: What the Eleventh Day Left
scenes.synopsis: Second entry, no new dated heading: Ilmen 11 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the day, with answer 386 and the count standing at 405 exact. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn at the kindling and flagstones, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge and the cold damper; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons only: neighbours going about the yard's ordinary grammar — a pail set where it always stands, a loaf pushed a finger's width and stopped with nobody calling the stopping a figure, barley passed from wall to wall without becoming a number, a rake raised at the Vail corner and set aside with nothing said. No Berr, Hessa, Ilva, collector, officer, reading, market, Cross or bell; no slate opened within reach of the basket, no figure given for the boy, no ownerless voice over the boards. Day already dated in Scene 1; nothing crosses forward from the morning as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. Dramatic purpose: the yard goes on in its ordinary grammar and the boy takes the small sounds first because they do not lie and the large ones are mostly weather; he goes around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, once and not twice, widest around the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come back, and gives the wide step no name, cause or figure, for a figure would want a payer standing (T098, T009/T013/T092). He keeps the called-gone grey the yard will one day burn beside the left-in-place ridge at the Vail corner with a finger between, and makes no fourth likeness a cause (T083/T085). Sella at the going of the light: hearth before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot's back, finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stays unread, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, turns the dressed grain under wool with no figure or handful, sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and carries him up and under the roof and never into the Debt Loft, putting the fold right at his ear and under his chin without a look at his face and adding no second fold (T077, T058/T079/T100, T097 held). Tarn takes the broom only after it has been given its instruction, says *Yes, house* to the thing behind the asking, keeps six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip, passes his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, and does not repeat the degree toward the landing; the warm loft stone stays unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiving (T036/T076/T006). Jorra knows the full note of a Vail pot three turns before it leaves his hands and withholds it from any High Kiln master who would call it early; he speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person and keeps the shed's silence (T062/T035/T031). In the small hours the towel comes out at the head of the bed as instruments come out when a case is done, and the boy goes over the field by the place of each thing with every gap left a gap: the crust's gap, the shelf's two gaps, the gone pan's round ring, the field's empty place, the keeping at the fold found where put and still a finding, the told bell's gap in its square beside the heard bell, the silence after the name from Weighing and the clean voice's missing name and the Long Night story's empty name on the gap tray, the neighbour's called-gone grey beside the left-in-place ridge, Tarn's ear-sentence stopped at the calling word in a term already ended, Jorra's promise neither given nor withdrawn, the clerk's inward slate at the out-of-line landing, Tarn's degree held as a shape and not repeated, and the man from Slate Row's face on its tray, filed and not counted among the nine record-first hands, never a tenth, never a sale, never a witness (T080/T090, T078, T061/T082, T081). Six hearings of the full note stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the Drawing's flat knock outside it; the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, the well-saying at four shapings, and the four old directions stand where put and do not repeat and buy no lesson (T061/T082, T101). Answer 386 filed; six honest answers on the sixth place, 381 through 386, not one a doctrine. Sensory anchors: pail set on stone, barley passed mouth to mouth, rake's rasp on the ridge, wet wool and banked coals, the towel rough from the wash and smelling of tallow and low smoke, the fourth low pull under the floor and the silence where the fifth stood. Foreshadowing: the first reading gone up the road gathers interest and is not brought back as a lesson; the kindness said low to the block on Ilmen 10 is not anticipated or paid. Emotional turn: the house's arithmetic kept badly in loaves and glances against the boy's exact count, and the satisfaction in a field left as found, which is not peace. Last image: the hand comes straight down on answer 386 and lies flat against the fold with the crust's corner standing a hair off the wool, the thread frozen and unwiped, four low pulls breathing below the floor with the fifth unsupplied, and the next morning still unbrought.

scenes.title: The Twelfth Morning
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and the second dated \daymark{406}{Ilmen 12, Y.H. 814, Secondday}: the small hours opening the day, then first light and the morning's work, with answer 387 and the count at 406 exact. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons only: neighbours at an ordinary morning's grammar along the wall and at the well; Ilva is not on stage in this scene and the runner's saying is not yet advanced. No Berr, collector, officer, reading, market, Cross or bell; no slate opened within reach of the basket and no figure given for the boy; Ilmen 20 stands eight mornings off and is not brought into a day that has not earned it. New day, new date, no recap: nothing from Ilmen 11 crosses forward as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. Dramatic purpose: the surgeon takes the body in its old order and reads the crust gone yet harder through the dry nights, the fold found where put, the frozen thread, cold stopping at the small bare wrist-joint and the Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform, while the infant wants the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle — both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086, T097/T060/T086). Sella comes to the hearth before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw in the voice another woman would use for a child who could not hear her, turns them with the back of a broken pot, counts intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, keeps her finger above the charcoal, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline of the original break showing between old-brass staple and tighter wire, says both proverbs to the pot and the fire and never to a person — *Leave the crack showing. People trust a thing they can see has been handled* and *If it's worth mending it's worth mending twice. The second time is the real one* — keeping repair apart from restoration as a surgeon keeps a graft apart from a cure, turns the dressed grain under wool with a touch lighter than a woman would use on a sleeping child and no figure or handful, and sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T009/T013/T092, T077). She carries him down and up at the half-pace from every open slate, goes wide around the seven walked-around places once and not twice, sets him under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, and adds no second fold; the widow's mark is not touched, because a morning, a hearth, a shelf and a basket are not openings and seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule (T058/T079). At the kindling Tarn keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip, tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, lets his hand go over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, and does not turn his head toward the landing; the ear-sentence stops at the calling word, a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled at the end of a term already ended (T036/T076/T006). Jorra comes through the finger's-width door from the room off the wheel-shed with the day's meal-fine grey slate dust white in a fist-crease, not the bone-coloured slip; he parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, asks neither which slate was broken nor whether it was a birth-slate, and withholds the full note he knows three turns ahead (T035/T031/T062). Answer 387 filed; the carried fire gives four low pulls with the fifth unpaid four hundred and six days and Garl's name unspoken the same number (T088). Sensory anchors: woodsmoke in wet wool, the sour tang of Ash at the unswept corner, the twice-mended pot's hairline dark between two metals, dry cold in the boards, the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back. Foreshadowing: the word that will come up from the well this afternoon is not anticipated; the four ownerless Ash and Slate directions stand where put and buy no lesson. Emotional turn: the adult's knowledge of how a thing holds a break and the child's hunger for the crust set two inches away, with Sella's proverbs going to the pot and the fire and never to a person. Last image: the hand outside the wool comes up an inch toward the river's note under its winter skin, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing, lets it go as the note ended, and comes down and lies flat against the fold on answer 387 — the keeping at the fold found where put, no second fold, the fifth pull under the floor unsupplied and the afternoon still unbrought.

scenes.title: The Figure That Named Somebody
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: Ilmen 12 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the day, with answer 388 and the count at 406 exact. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail, Ilva at the yard well; Garl Vail in objects. Hessa Rale is on stage only as the unnamed subject of a word, not a sighting and not a reader made; the soft-cuffed clerk and the man from Slate Row stay on their own trays and are not brought up to stand beside the basket. Walk-ons only: the bucket-round at the well and neighbours going about the yard. No collector, officer, reading, market, Cross or bell; no slate opened within reach of the basket, no figure given for the boy, no ownerless voice over the boards. Day already dated in Scene 3; nothing crosses forward from the morning as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. THE CHAPTER'S ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE, advanced and NOT paid: word comes up once at the yard well that the woman who carries the slate once carried a figure that named a person she knew — a fifth shaping of the well-saying, on a place of its own beside Hessa Rale's eighth hand and the Cross-to-Greybank road saying with a finger between every pair, no owner standing, no name spoken over the figure, no confession, no reader made and no sixth shaping made due (T080/T090 advanced, not paid). The four ownerless Ash 5 joining and Ash 17, Ash 23 and Stone 23 directions are NOT made a sixth shaping and are not joined to it; shapings are not a witness and the fifth buys no payer. Ilva draws at the well with the pail against her knee, clay pale in her nail crescents and grey rack dust in one thumb seam, her hand to her sleeve before her eyes to the asker and her mouth after both; the notched strip stays unread in its fold, no figure comes off the wood, she answers the question put and not the one behind it and is expressly not the speaker of the well-saying, her ninth record-first hand stays nine with no tenth (T080 held). Sella at the going of the light keeps the whole hearth grammar — fire before basket, coals told the thaw, intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger above the unread charcoal, lips on a two-gapped row, clay jar glanced at once with the hand half over nothing, twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure or handful, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, carried up under the roof and never into the Debt Loft, fold righted without a look at his face, no second fold (T058/T079/T100, T077, T097). Tarn keeps six and the seventh, passes his hand over blade and sill and away with no held breath, tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, does not repeat the degree toward the landing, and leaves the ear-sentence stopped at the calling word as the ninth stopping with no tenth, the loan uncalled and the Seed 16 breath unspent (T036/T076/T006). Jorra parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, withholds the full note three turns ahead and takes his bent finger out of the damper without the extra holding of Ash 26; the promise stays neither given nor withdrawn and *he's not Vail* sealed (T062/T035/T031). In the small hours the boy goes over the field by the place of each thing: the well-saying's fifth shaping on its own tray between the eighth hand and the road saying, the first arithmetic gone up the road in Berr's locked box with no key, the twelve old findings behind one unsigned figure with the new figure not laid across them, the keeping at the fold found where put, the six hearings with the seventh place empty and the Drawing's knock outside, nine hands with no tenth and nine stoppings with no tenth, the four rooms with the same gap held apart, the green and the shape as sightings with no eighth, the clerk's inward slate and Tarn's degree on separate places, and the face on its tray (T061/T082, T080/T090, T015/T041/T047, T081, T050/T051, T033/T034 held). Emotions and senses: the exact hush of a neighbour's word at a well, the bucket's small rasp on the stone lip, clay in nail crescents, the boy's clinical taking-apart of a shaping that wants a witness where none stands, and the infant's three wants quarrelling without verdict under it. Foreshadowing planted, not paid: the fifth shaping gathers toward the far-off hand that will lay the district's private keepings together and call the joining an account; Berr's kindness from Ilmen 10, the unread slate and the clerk's inward slate go on their own trays; no sixth shaping, tenth hand, seventh hearing, signature, payer, witness, reader or reader of the strip stands. Emotional turn: a word that names nobody under it gathers interest without becoming a witness, while a woman who keeps a count in wood refuses to make an account of it. Last image: the hand comes down on answer 388 and lies flat against the fold, the fifth shaping kept on its own tray with a finger between it and both the eighth hand and the road saying, the thread frozen and unwiped, and the fourth low pull under the floor still wanting its fifth.

Offstage and kept where put: Ilva with her strip in her sleeve, the well-saying's fifth shaping on its own tray, Hessa's eighth hand and the road saying, Berr up the clay road with the box locked, the clerk at the landing, the man from Slate Row on his tray. No Berr on stage, no collector, officer, reading, market, Cross or bell; no slate opened within reach of the basket, no figure given for the boy. New day, new date, no recap: the fifth shaping is found where put and is not repeated, made due, named or joined to any other kept thing (T080 held). Dramatic purpose: the surgeon takes the body in its old order — crust two inches off with its corner hair-lifted, fold found where put, thread stiff in the dry heat and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint, the Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — knowing a basket set level out of the draught is the careful rewarming he would choose and cannot ask for, while the infant's three wants quarrel without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086, T097/T060/T086). Sella at the morning hearth comes before the basket, tells the coals the thaw, turns them with a broken pot's back, keeps the charcoal unread and the grain covered and unfigured, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, carries him down and up at the half-pace from every open slate, goes wide around the seven walked-around places once and not twice, widest around the returning-line place, sets him under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right without a look at his face and adds no second fold, and leaves the widow's mark untouched (T058/T079/T100, T077, T098, T009/T013/T092). At the kindling Tarn keeps six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, the knife at the edge of its sill, his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, and does not look along the road or repeat the degree toward the landing, the ear-sentence stopped at the calling word with the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled at the very end of an ended term (T036/T076/T006). Jorra comes through the finger's-width door with meal-fine grey slate dust white in a fist-crease, parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, knows the full note three turns ahead and withholds it from any High Kiln master who would call it early, and puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence and out without the extra holding of Ash 26; *he's not Vail* stays sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn while the burned slate stands at five and the four directions apart and unspent (T062/T035/T031/T065/T095). Answer 389 filed; the carried fire gives four low pulls with the fifth unpaid four hundred and seven days and Garl's name unspoken the same number, the two counts standing side by side without becoming one (T088). Sensory anchors: grey dust worked small as meal, the leathery crust gone past the point where a child would still eat it, dry cold at the bare wrist-joint, the little-door burn closing on air as the clay jar is glanced at and left, the river's low note under its winter skin through the finger's-width door. Foreshadowing: the first arithmetic gone up the road and the fifth shaping at the well go on gathering toward far-off accountings; Ilmen 20's second reading stands one morning beyond next chapter's close and is not named as a boundary here. Emotional turn: the quiet after a word at the well is kept as a quiet, and the boy's exact count runs on under a house that cannot say what it counts. Last image: the hand outside the wool comes up an inch toward the river's note under its winter skin, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing, lets it go as the note ended, and comes down and lies flat against the fold on answer 389 — the fifth shaping found where put and not made again, no second fold, the fifth pull under the floor unsupplied.

scenes.title: The Thirteenth Day's Close
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Ilmen 13 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the chapter, with answer 390 and the count at 407 exact. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Offstage with keepings found where put: Tarn at the kindling and flagstones, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed and cold damper, Ilva with her strip in her sleeve, Hessa's eighth hand on its tray and the fifth shaping of the well-saying on its own tray, Berr Clay up the clay road with the box locked, the soft-cuffed clerk at the out-of-line landing, the man from Slate Row on his tray. Walk-ons only: neighbours settling into the ordinary grammar of the tend. No second telling at the well brought forward, no market, no collector called, no present-tense break and no \memory{} tag. Day already dated in Scene 5; nothing from this afternoon crosses under the roof as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and Ilmen 14 (Day 408) stands one morning beyond the close and is not brought into a day that has not earned it. Dramatic purpose: the yard goes on in its ordinary grammar and the boy takes the field as found and leaves it as found, going around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, once and not twice, and keeping the wide step as a keeping and not a sign (T098, T009/T013/T092). Costs arrive as directions and go away as weather and leave no entry: a number rises out of a fist toward the well, looks at the light and goes back into a sleeve, and a woman sent to the pot gets no figure from a pot (T077). Sella at the going of the light: hearth before basket, coals told the thaw, finger along the top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stays unread, twice-mended pot lifted thumb-first where the wire crosses the crack with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure or handful — the arithmetic read on Ilmen 10 over grain covered at home did not know what it cost and the space between the two figures has no signature — and pot rim set two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T077, T058/T079/T100). She carries him up the nineteen steps at the half-pace, goes wide around the seven walked-around places once and not twice, sets him under the roof and never into the Debt Loft, puts the fold right at his ear and under his chin without a look at his face and adds no second fold; the keeping at the fold is found where put and stays a finding, still not a placing, with no second fold, third crust, name, gift, payment or payer (T097/T060/T086). The widow's mark is not touched — a hearth, a shelf, a well and a going of the light are not openings, seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule and no eighth is made due (T058/T079). In the small hours the towel comes out at the head of the bed as instruments come out when a case is done, and the boy goes over the field by the place of each thing with every gap left a gap: the crust's gap, the shelf's two gaps, the gone pan's round ring, the field's empty place, the keeping at the fold found where put and still a finding, the told bell's gap in its square beside the heard bell, the silence after the name from Weighing and the clean voice's missing name and the Long Night story's empty name on the gap tray, the neighbour's called-gone grey beside the left-in-place ridge, Tarn's ear-sentence stopped at the calling word in a term already ended, Jorra's promise under the wheel-shed neither given nor withdrawn, Garl's unforged collector sentence beside the seventh notch and his name unspoken the same number as the fire's fifth, the well-saying's fifth shaping on its own tray between the eighth hand and the road saying, the clerk's inward slate and Tarn's degree on separate places, Berr's low saying about kindness entered on a place of its own beside neither the twelve findings nor the new figure, and the man from Slate Row's face on its tray, filed and not counted among the nine record-first hands (T080/T090, T078, T061/T082, T081, T009/T013/T092, T036/T076/T006). Six hearings of the full note stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the Drawing's knock outside; nine hands stay nine with no tenth and nine stoppings nine with no tenth, and no eighth opening, seventh hearing, sixth shaping of the well-saying, thirteenth arithmetic, signature, payer, witness, reader or payment stood (T061/T082). The first arithmetic of Y.H. 814 stands gone up the road in Berr's locked box with the key gone up in a coat pocket that never comes back down and the boy having no key; it is one reading and not an account, and he does not lay twelve old findings across it to make a row come out even, for paper is not a payer (T015/T041/T047 held, not paid). Answer 390 filed: exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across neither the twelve readings, the new figure, the fifth shaping, the bell's gap, the flat knock, the child's grey fingertips, the mother's cup, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb's resting, the held breath, the two bites of iron, the river's skin, the widow's mark, the fourth direction, the clerk's inward slate, the green at the pot board, the shape at the market's edge, Berr's low saying nor the keeping at the fold; six honest answers stand on the sixth place, 385 through 390, and not one is a doctrine. Count four hundred and seven exact, six months and two hundred and twenty-seven days told by nobody; the carried fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number, the two counts standing side by side without becoming one (T071/T072, T088). The surgeon takes his small clean satisfaction in a field taken as found and left as found and knows it costs nothing, which is how he knows it is not peace; under it, louder, the body wants the crust lifted two inches, the thread at the mouth wiped and a hand on the pot board's handle, and gets none of the three. Nothing was opened, joined, named, called, paid, forgiven or ended, and no door was drawn across the tend. Sensory anchors: tallow and low smoke in the rough towel, the crust's corner a hair off the wool, the thread stiff and unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint, the river's note low under its winter skin through the finger's-width door, four low pulls under the floor with the fifth unsupplied, four nails on the near board, four on the next and a thumb-width knot where a fifth might have been driven and was not. Foreshadowing: the fifth shaping gone up from the well and the first reading gone up the road gather interest toward the hand not his that will one day lay the private keepings together; Jorra's promise, Tarn's valuable ear and ended term, the clerk's inward slate, Berr's kindness, the burning of the slate at five and the four directions stand where put, advanced and not paid, and do not repeat. Emotional turn: a word came up from a well and a figure went up a road, and under the roof nothing has changed hands; the boy keeps the exactness without making a doctrine of either. Last image: the hand outside the wool comes up an inch toward the river's note under its winter skin, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing, lets it go as the note ended — neither early nor stayed — and comes straight down and lays itself flat against the fold on answer 390 as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking; the crust's corner stands a hair off the wool, the thread is frozen and unwiped, four low pulls breathe below the floor with the fifth unsupplied, the first arithmetic of the year is up the road in a locked box with no key in his hand, the fifth shaping sits on its own tray with a finger between it and every other kept thing, and the house goes on as a house goes when a pot is set down in its place and the fire kept — forward, into Ilmen 14.
